revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Agree with you, James. The space between mu and nu is too wide and the shape of the letter does not resemble the other omegas but rather omicron. Then, there must be another letter missing, for which I have no guess --> [.1]. I would consider not to place a dot under thy upsilon. In line 1, there are traces of chi --> Ἐτέαρχ̣[ος.
Vote - AcceptText - Yes the dotted upsilon does look good. I wonder whether ρισμῶ̣ν υ̣ is correct. ρισμὸ̣ν̣ νυ̣ or ρισμο̣ὶ̣ νυ̣ might be better.

Submit - At the end of l. 3 (ro) there are visible traces of an upsilon with its arms joined at a right angle.From the digital photo, Cf. http://www.psionline.it/images/orig/PSI%20XIII%201353%20r%20.jpg?1296070669
Commit - From the digital photo, there are visible traces of an upsilon with its arms joined at a right angle. Cf. http://www.psionline.it/images/orig/PSI%20XIII%201353%20r%20.jpg?1296070669
